==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. What looked like a meteor was heading straight for the village. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) I used the Reality Warping Stone to shield the village, and discovered that the meteor was an alien dinosaur curled into a ball. (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.) (Alien Meteor Dinosaurs resemble very large alien dinosaurs with spiky triangle shaped heads and rocky scaly hides. They can curl themselves into balls to move through space to other planets.) (The shield barrier resembled a glowing purple barrier made up of octagon shaped panels.) More came raining down, so I had to expand the barrier to protect the entire planet from destruction.
